protocol.trigger: 5/10/15% close drawdown from running peak; nonoverlap within scale; 90 consecutive days warmup
protocol.end: 15% close rebound then 10% close correction, 120 calendar day cap; gaps and incomplete excluded in main
protocol.targets: median low ratio capped at .95, median high ratio floored at 1.05; Q75 low capped at .95
protocol.first_touch: historical replay of same relative asymmetric target pair on completed prior episodes; 4-category Laplace baseline versus 50% blend with 8 ATR nearest neighbors; matched complete hourly OHLC only for ambiguous daily order
protocol.execution: next open market, fee .05% each side, market slippage .05% each side, limit fills assumed at specified price, no same-bar new limit fill and sale, cancel remaining order at sale, no reentry, end close liquidation, close-marked MDD; strict crossing sensitivity
protocol.selection: 2020–22, test 2023+ previously viewed; min10 tune, both Brier and logloss improve 5% for ATR; trade candidate beats cash and market in mean and no higher mean MDD than market in tune

cap_sensitivity.note: Post-hoc include cap-ended episodes; training unchanged; still exclude end-of-data cases.

limitations: No daily first-touch ambiguity in scored events, so hourly tie-resolution benefit not demonstrated; one Q75 same-bar buy/sell ambiguous per 5% and 10% test (not counted as immediate sale).
Strict crossing sensitivity unchanged on main test.
MDD based on daily closing marks, not intraday maximum.
Limit fills assumed full; no tick rounding, queue, orderbook or liquidity validation.
Overlapping scales and reused periods; no independent prospective validation; USD/Bithumb not tested.
No validated probabilities or production changes. Full local scripts/results available in chat; this commit saves summary only.
